pr_title: fix(es/minifier): Don't inline regex for IIFEs

issue_context.title: Avoid inlining regex in loop conditional
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

SWC compression will currently inline a regex, even if doing so might change the behavior for global (/g) and sticky(/y) regular expressions. When these flags are included, the regex will [keep an internal state](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/RegExp/exec#description) of the `lastIndex` matched. By inlining these regex in certain scenarios, such as a while loop condition, you can cause the internal state to be reset each time the code is run

### Input code

```typescript
function run(str, r) {
  let m
  while(m = r.exec(str)) {
    console.log(m)
  }
}
run('abcda', /a/g)
```

### Expected behavior

The regex should not be inlined

```
!function(str, r) {
    let m;
    for(; m = r.exec(str);)console.log(m);
}('abcda', /a/g);
```

### Actual behavior

The regex is inlined, which can lead to an infinite loop

```
!function(str, r) {
    let m;
    for(; m = /a/g.exec(str);)console.log(m);
}('abcda', 0);
```

### Version

1.3.11
